steps.action: Archive the template (Archive control, Archive template), check creation, then Show archived > Restore
steps.expected: The archived template is not offered and a creation that names it is refused with a clear message; Restore brings its saved definition back.
steps.actual: Archive dialog: "Archive DOC-030 contracts-c onboarding template 20260925113332? The template leaves new Matter creation. After Archive template the Create matter dialog offered ["No template"]; a create naming the archived template answered 400 "The template must be live and belong to the selected matter type.". steps.action: Archive a Document steps 1-3: open the Documents tab, the Document's Actions menu, Archive; check it leaves the list; turn on Show archived
steps.expected: The Document leaves the normal list and reappears marked Archived with Show archived on; its 3 Versions, files, primary mark and executed designation stay.
steps.actual: Row menu offered ["Compare with previous","Mark as executed copy","Add version","Edit details","Move to folder","Mark confidential","Archive"]. Archive removed "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx" from the list; Show archived drew "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx Primary Archived Draft · theirs v3 Sep 25 Uploaded by Nadia Haddad NH". Read-back: 3 Versions, still primary, executed designation on Version 2, every Version download 200. The Documents repository search (200) did not list it.

steps.action: Restore a Document steps 1-3 on the owning record: Show archived, the row's Actions menu, Restore
steps.expected: The Document is live again with its 3 Versions, its primary mark and its executed designation.
steps.actual: Restore in the archived row's Actions menu made it live. With Show archived off its row reads "archive-main-legal-20260925114020.docx Primary No type Draft · ours Draft · theirs Redline · theirs Redline · ours Executed Amendment DOC-03"; read-back keeps 3 Versions, primary, executed designation on Version 2.

steps.action: Archive several live Documents: select their checkboxes and Archive in the selection bar; then, with Show archived on, select both and Restore in the selection bar
steps.expected: Both leave the list together and return together.
steps.actual: Selection bar for two live Documents read "2 selected Move Archive"; Archive removed both rows. With Show archived on, selecting both and Restore made both live again.

steps.action: Restore a Document step 1 and 2 in the Documents repository: Filter, Show archived, then the repository's Restore action
steps.expected: Without Show archived the archived Document is not listed; with it, the row is marked Archived and Restore makes it live.
steps.actual: With the Record filter set to C-449, the repository listed its live Documents (3 rows) but not the archived one; Filter > Show archived added "archive-repo-legal-20260925114020.txt Archived C-449 · DOC-030 contracts-c archive-and-delete Legal 20260925114020 Draft · ours TXT 46 byte"; its Restore action made it live (read-back).

steps.action: If restoration is refused because the owning record is archived: archive the Contract (setup), try to restore its archived Document, restore the Contract first, then restore the Document
steps.expected: While the Contract is archived there is no Show archived or change control and restoring is refused; after restoring the Contract the Document restores.
steps.actual: Archived C-449: no Show archived switch, no Upload, row menus offered ["Compare with previous"]; restoring the Document answered 409 "This contract is archived. Restore it before changing its paper.". After the Contract was restored, Show archived > Restore made the Document live.

steps.action: Restore a Document: a second session restores the same archived Document first; this page selects Restore on its stale row, reads the message and reloads
steps.expected: A stale-state message shows; after reload the Document is live.
steps.actual: A second session restored the Document while this page still showed it archived. Restore on the stale row showed "This document is not archived.". After reload it was live.
